about_the_game:
Washed ashore with nothing but memories of your death, you find yourself on a journey to explore the oppressive Purgatorial Realms and escape the Afterlife.

Face difficult choices in who you wish to take upon your journey and who you wish to damn to the corruption of the lands. Witness their horrific transformations of their greatest desires and wishes and strike them down with a unique turn-based weapon system.

Carefully craft your party before each venture into the lands and listen to their unique perspectives on the world before.

Taking inspiration from monster collector challenge runs and blending it with dark fantasy elements,  End the Endless offers an oppressive, challenging environment where players must discover what happens when death is no longer the greatest fear.

  • Choose between 3 different souls to begin your journey and recruit a variety of others from the Purgatorial Realms.

  • Make careful decisions between who you take in your journey and who you must slay to carry onward.

  • Each weapon and tome offers their own unique attacks and spells requiring careful planning before each encounter. 

  • Randomized elements ensure that you never have the same tools at your disposal for the horrors ahead.

  • Hand-pixeled artwork with a dark atmosphere set in an isometric environment

Content Warning:

Elements of self-harm are present immediately from the onset of this game. References to hangings, self-mutilation and executions are common and in some cases - a core part of the lore.

The Purgatorial Realms features adjacency to the works of religious scholars but does not refer to any religious elements from existing faiths directly.

content_descriptors.notes:
End the Endless contains scenes of fantasy violence using fantasy weapons. This is typically indicated using a 2D effect laid over a 2D sprite (eg: A slash effect overlayed on a character).

The game features  body horror via cut to black sequences and contains images of monsters.

Censored nudity takes place in game in the form of breasts partially exposed but nipples not visible. 

The game features references adjacent to but not directly to Catholicism via similarities to the works of Dante's Puragatorio 

The game features imagery related to self harm and suicide with imagery of nooses around character sprites and environment assets (eg: Statues).

short_description: End the Endless is a dark fantasy turn based RPG set in the Purgatorial Realms. Harness unique directional based weapon systems in an oppressive environment. Utilize blades, sanity, limbs and even your party members as a resource. Explore the Afterlife and seek to conquer the Seven Terraces.
